findings.description: Success criterion 2 reads unconditionally: 'A fixture programme can create one phase, one loop, and one external task on every target host.' loop-007-7 measured this directly on all four target hosts and its own 'Criterion 2, scored' section states: 'Criterion 2 is met on codex, cursor and opencode, and failed on claude-code, and the failure has a named cause, a shipped citation, and an existing owner.' The claude-code adapter installs a different skill set from the other three (9 skills, no shared router, no envelope writer), and its own installed platforms/claude-code/commands/next-loop.md:355-359 states in its own shipped text: 'nothing in this adapter writes one... Migrating the adapter to emit an envelope is a Phase 7 item.' loop-007-7's own check 4 explicitly required this outcome to be 'recorded as the result with its blocker named, not as a deferral' -- the loop's own author anticipated and pre-empted a temptation to file this as deferred rather than failed. Unlike criterion 1, which plan.md was formally rewritten to match on 2026-09-03 with a dated, reasoned note, criterion 2's text in plan.md was never amended, narrowed, or given a recorded operator waiver. PLANNING.md (line 9, entry dated 2026-09-02) records the operator's decision as 'remediate everything, including host discovery, having been offered the narrower option of waiving criteria 1 and 2' -- the operator was offered and declined a waiver of criterion 2 specifically, which forecloses reading the unaddressed gap as an implicit acceptance.

failure_notes: Criterion 2, as written in plan.md ('a fixture programme can create one phase, one loop, and one external task on every target host'), is measured failed on claude-code by loop-007-7's own evidence. This is the sole blocking finding. All other five criteria are met on direct verification in the subject checkout at C:/Users/mharvey2/.herdr/worktrees/advanced-planning/loop-008-gate: criterion 1's install_audit.py SURFACES includes core/skills with shared_namespace handling and run-gate.md uses --layers source,global; criterion 3's evidence_gate.py calls validate_path_scope at production sites; criterion 4's evidence_gate.py has a __main__/CLI, ap_launcher.py detects absent __main__ structurally rather than by enumerated allow-list, and platforms/shared/agent-skills/advanced-planning/SKILL.md wires the gate at both the loop-complete and collected-evidence sites; criterion 5's path_audit.py DEFAULT_SCANNED_ROOTS includes core/schemas, core/state, platforms/cursor, setup/cursor, and its host-directory regex includes .agents/; criterion 6 confirmed by absence of any SKILL.md under platforms/{codex,opencode,cursor}. Before the next gate attempt: either close the claude-code envelope gap (loop-007-7 already names this a Phase 7 item, which is a scope decision the phase plan itself has not recorded), or have the operator explicitly amend plan.md's criterion 2 the same way criterion 1 was amended, with a dated note recording the reason and the carried limitation -- the operator was offered exactly this waiver on 2026-09-02 and declined it, so re-offering it now needs an explicit fresh decision, not a quiet reading of loop-007-7's prose as sufficient.
